CREATIVE ARTS — MOCK EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Descant Recorder.
   C. Damage equipment used for Descant Recorder.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Descant Recorder.

2. Best practice when working on Volleyball: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Volleyball.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Volleyball.

8. Best practice when working on Gymnastics: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Gymnastics.
   B. Practise Gymnastics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Gymnastics.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Gymnastics.

9. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles.

14. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The speed of the music
   B. Only the costume
   C. Only the volume
   D. The ticket price

15. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre: (1 mark)

----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Melody and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Athletics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
